cache_type.description: The instance type/cache type for the PCU group. Defaults to 'STANDARD'. Changing this value requires replacement.

id.description: The unique identifier of the PCU group.

org_id.description: The organization ID that owns this PCU group.

reserved_capacity.description: The reserved (committed) capacity units for the PCU group. Must be at least 0. Changing this value when reserved_protection is enabled will result in an error.

reserved_protection.description: When enabled, prevents accidental reserved capacity unit increases. Defaults to true.

status.description: The current status of the PCU group (e.g., ACTIVE, PARKED, CREATING, TERMINATING).

update.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

block.description: `astra_private_link` provides a private link resource. Private Link is a private network endpoint that can be created to connect from your vpc to Astra without using a publicly routable IP address. `astra_private_link` resources are associated with a database id. Once the private_link resource is created in Astra it must be linked to an endpoint within your vpc, use `astra_private_link_endpoint` to do this.

resolve_datacenter.description: Resolves the datacenter ID for a given database and optional region (if the database has multiple regions). Helpful for components that require a datacenter ID such as PCU group associations and private links.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: The database object to resolve the datacenter from. This should be the result of an "astra_database" resource or data source.

variadic_parameter.name: region
variadic_parameter.description: The region to resolve the datacenter for. If not provided, the function will attempt to resolve the datacenter if there is only one configured.
